# College Company

> College Company — the alternative institution: micro-courses, beyond-varsity competitions, and compliant earning for the general collegiate population.

Founded and led by Kevin Mitchell in Boston, Massachusetts, College Company organizes student-first programs across four public doors:

- **Learn** (`/learn`): College Creator Academy (`/learn/college-creator-academy`), NIL Money 101 (`/learn/nil-money-101`), For Parents & Guardians (`/learn/for-parents`), EsportsEducation.com (`/learn/esports-education`), and College Creator Lab (`/learn/college-creator-lab`).
- **Compete** (`/compete`): College Esports Expo (CEX) (`/compete/college-esports-expo`), College Drone Racing League (CDRL) (`/compete/college-drone-racing-league`), College Racing League (CRL) (`/compete/college-racing-league`), College GTA (`/compete/college-gta`), and AGONiQ (`/compete/agoniq`) — open to the general student body, not only varsity.
- **Earn** (`/earn`): NIL Brand Match / Placement Desk (`/earn/nil-brand-match`) and College NIL Hub (`/earn/college-nil-hub`) under the Student-First Charter (brands pay a disclosed fee; students pay zero commission).
- **Trust** (`/trust`): NIL Compliance Pro (`/trust/nil-compliance-pro`) and PlayerNIL.org (`/trust/player-nil`) — NIL reporting, FTC disclosure, and tax literacy woven into every program.
